digest.en: Estonia pushes Europe to bar Russian fighters. China's AI governance model gains attention in the Global South. Rescuers in China search for survivors after a landslip.
digest.hi: आज बोर्ड पर एशिया-पैसिफिक क्षेत्र में एक रोबोट की एंट्री से प्लांट ठप्प होने की खबर है। पाकिस्तान को खंड-खंड करने की धमकी दी जा रही है। मिडिल ईस्ट में तनाव के बीच अमेरिका ने लेबनान यात्रा से बचने की सलाह दी है।

articles.title: 'Sooner Or Later This Problem Will Be On Your Soil': Estonia Pushes Europe To Bar Russian Fighters
articles.summary: As Russia's war against Ukraine reshapes Europe's security landscape, Estonia is closely watching the Kremlin's next moves. In an interview with RFE/RL, Estonia's Undersecretary for Internal Security Joosep Kaasik discusses why Tallinn believes prevention is Europe's best defense. 'Sooner Or Later This Problem Will Be On Your Soil': Estonia Pushes Europe To Bar Russian Fighters.

articles.title: 'We Have To Be Realists' Regarding Threats From Russia
articles.summary: Joosep Kaasik, the undersecretary for internal security in Estonia's Ministry of the Interior, told RFE/RL in an interview that his country takes the threat of a potential Russian attack seriously, but is also prepared to deal with the use of soft power by its Eastern neighbor. 'We Have To Be Realists' Regarding Threats From Russia.

articles.title: Rescuers race to find survivors in rain after landslip in China kills at least eight

articles.title: Bangladesh shelves India reset as tensions trump trust
articles.summary: Driven by shifting domestic political dynamics and a transforming regional landscape, Bangladesh’s new prime minister, Tarique Rahman, who came to power after a landslide in February this year, has shelved plans to visit its most consequential neighbor, India, for the time being. articles.summary: China had earlier announced that the US decision to allow the expiration of Trump's national emergency declaration over Hong Kong would restore the territory's special trade and economic status, but US officials disputed this assessment. US lifts some Hong Kong sanctions imposed by Trump, autonomy status unchanged.

articles.title: New US Attacks On Roads, Bridges Reported As Iran Hits Back At Gulf States
articles.summary: US strikes on Iran widened early on July 18 from the Strait of Hormuz hotspot to multiple sites throughout central and southern Iran, including through the use of fighter jets, while Iran continued to pound US Gulf allies, as a fragile cease-fire further tattered. New US Attacks On Roads, Bridges Reported As Iran Hits Back At Gulf States.

articles.title: Reopening Hormuz Strait Easier Than Restoring Confidence, Naval Analyst Tallis Says
articles.summary: With the US and Iran launching fresh strikes in the Middle East, the Strait of Hormuz is back under the spotlight. Naval strategist Joshua Tallis says restoring commercial confidence -- not military force alone -- will determine when shipping returns to normal. Reopening Hormuz Strait Easier Than Restoring Confidence, Naval Analyst Tallis Says.

articles.title: Ukrainians Protest For A Second Day Over Defense Minister's Dismissal
articles.summary: Protests spread across Ukraine on July 17, two days after President Volodymyr Zelenskyy sacked the country's popular defense minister, Mykhaylo Fedorov, in a cabinet shakeup. articles.title: Ukraine Claims New Strikes On Russian 'Shadow Fleet' Tankers
articles.summary: Ukraine said its drones struck 159 vessels it identifies as part of Russia’s shadow fleet during a 12‑day campaign in the Black Sea Kyiv says it has hit 159 vessels linked to Russia's so-called shadow fleet during a 12-day drone campaign in the Black Sea and Sea of Azov. Ukrainian officials have said the operation is aimed at disrupting the transportation of oil and other shipments used to evade international sanctions.

articles.title: Thai prisoners brew a path back to daily life
articles.summary: It looks like a regular coffee shop, albeit set up in an old red bus. Stairs lead up to a serving hatch, with a menu of drink options. A selection of jaunty coffee-related messages like “My one and only love: Americano” and “Miss you a latte,” adorn the side of the bus. Thai prisoners brew a path back to daily life.

articles.title: UN chief calls for new diplomatic push following attacks on civilian areas
articles.summary: The UN Secretary-General remains deeply concerned by the continuing deadly military escalation between Iran and the United States, his spokesperson said on Friday as attacks destroyed key civilian and military infrastructure across the Gulf region. UN chief calls for new diplomatic push following attacks on civilian areas.

articles.title: Emergency alert spotlights sharp hunger spike
articles.summary: More than 256,000 people in Djibouti – around 25 per cent of the population – are likely to face crisis or emergency level hunger over the coming months, a UN-backed global food monitoring network warned in a new report released Friday. Emergency alert spotlights sharp hunger spike.

articles.summary: This month, multiple media outlets reported that satellite imagery showed a detailed, full-scale replica of a US Navy Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer in China’s remote Taklamakan Desert. articles.title: US Attacks, Iran Retaliates -- But White House Insists Diplomacy Still Possible
articles.summary: US forces stepped up attacks on Iranian sites, reportedly striking key bridges and an airport, prompting retaliatory action by Tehran, even while the White House said talks between the warring sides were still under way and that diplomacy was still a viable option. US Attacks, Iran Retaliates -- But White House Insists Diplomacy Still Possible.

articles.title: Russian Fuel Shortages Trigger Fights, Public Anger
articles.summary: Worsening fuel shortages are causing more frustration across Russia, with social media videos regularly showing fist fights at gas stations and drivers demanding answers from authorities. The Kremlin claims the country's energy system remains resilient. Russian Fuel Shortages Trigger Fights, Public Anger.

articles.title: IOM warns of potential El Niño threat to families displaced by earthquake
articles.summary: Thousands of people remain displaced three weeks after the devastating earthquakes in Venezuela and the possible formation of a strong El Niño climate pattern could worsen their already dire situation, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) warned on Thursday. IOM warns of potential El Niño threat to families displaced by earthquake.

articles.title: ईरान से लड़ने निकले ट्रंप, उधर अमेरिका जला, डूबा और धुएं में घुटा, अब कनाडा को टैरिफ की धमकी
articles.summary: अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने कनाडा पर जंगलों का सही प्रबंधन नहीं करने का आरोप लगाया और अतिरिक्त टैरिफ लगाने की धमकी दी। अमेरिका इस समय एक साथ तीन बड़े संकटों से जूझ रहा है. पूर्वी राज्यों में कनाडा के जंगल की आग का धुआं, टेक्सास में भीषण बाढ़ और पश्चिमी राज्यों में 68 बड़ी जंगल की आग ने हालात गंभीर बना दिए हैं.
